corrections.problem: All2D pixels receiving light the same way is too broad.
corrections.accurateMeaning: With equal normals under a common directional light, the angle contribution matches; color,position,attenuation and other shading inputs may differ. Lit2D sprites can already react to lights.

corrections.problem: Do not confuse stored direction with height,display paint or world axes.
corrections.accurateMeaning: Normal Map stores per-texel shading directions. For tangent-spaceRGB interpretation, the local tangent frame matters; genericRGB*2-1 illustrates encoding, not every Unity compressed texture layout.

corrections.problem: Apparent bumps do not demonstrate new physical geometry.
corrections.accurateMeaning: Normal mapping changes shading, not mesh vertices,silhouette or colliders; side viewing reveals the underlying surface. The reference wall shots do not establish an identical-mesh controlled toggle.

corrections.problem: Do not generalize character-frame baking to every Dead Cells normal asset.
corrections.accurateMeaning: The character pipeline exported animationPNG frames with matching normal maps; the environment account separately describes hand-drawn Photoshop normals.

corrections.problem: Do not claim identical normal mapping across every Dead Cells version.
corrections.accurateMeaning: A dated2022mobile-port developer note says mobile omitted normal mapping. Use verifiedPC/console observation for the historical implementation and do not imply a current2026binary measurement.

corrections.problem: Efficient does not mean free or universally faster.
corrections.accurateMeaning: Extra texture data/sampling and renderer passes have costs. Compare with explicitly modeled equivalent fine detail; claim no measured FPS gain without an actual controlled measurement.
